contribution_types.general: Evaluate the claimed contribution and evidence without imposing a particular paper genre.
contribution_types.theory: Prioritize precise assumptions, valid reasoning, proof completeness and conceptual value. Do not require experiments or leaderboard comparisons for a theoretical contribution.
contribution_types.use_inspired: Check the real problem, stakeholder-relevant metrics and practical constraints. Include relevant domain and non-ML baselines; justify any demand for standard ML benchmarks.
contribution_types.concept_feasibility: Evaluate originality and potential significance alongside a sound feasibility demonstration. Distinguish demonstrated claims from a plausible research direction; do not demand a mature benchmark suite by default.
contribution_types.negative_results: Assess whether the negative finding is informative, important and supported by diagnostic analysis. Separate a meaningful limitation from an under-tuned run. A remedy is not mandatory.
